internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to High CPU Utilization
internal.body:
At 11:49 UTC on 2026-11-08, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service. Diagnosis identified high CPU utilization as the primary cause, linked to the adHighCpu flag being enabled. The flag was disabled at 12:08 UTC, resulting in a rapid recovery of service latency to normal levels. No significant memory or error rate anomalies were observed. The incident was resolved promptly after the flag was turned off.

Timeline:
- 11:49:01: Alert received for high latency in ad service.
- 12:08:49: Diagnosis confirmed high CPU utilization as cause.
- 12:08:56: Flag adHighCpu disabled.
- 12:08:56: Recovery verified with latency metrics returning to normal.

Actions taken:
- Disabled the adHighCpu flag to reduce CPU load.

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring CPU utilization flags and their impact on service latency.

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 11:49 and 12:09 UTC on 2026-11-08, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting system settings to reduce CPU load. Service performance has returned to normal, and no further impact is expected.
